NEW / 3D MARS ADVENTURE

Akustik: The Way Home

Crash-land on Mars, explore the valley and discover NASA landers and rovers. Find the missing parts, repair your ship and help Akustik fly home.

Play The Way Home ↗

How to play

W / A / S / D to move, Shift to run, Space to jump, and Enter to pick up or use items. Drag the mouse to turn the camera.

On a phone, use the left stick to move, drag the right side to look around, and tap JUMP or USE.

EXSPACE ARCADE

Akustik: Space Flight

Dodge asteroids and aliens, fly past the planets, and reach the galaxy.

Open full screen ↗

How to play

← → or A / D to steer. ↑ / W to boost, ↓ / S to brake. Press P to pause.

On a phone, drag your finger across the game. With a mouse, move the pointer above Akustik to boost.

Click Start inside the game to begin. Your best distance is saved on this device.
